mnemonic.description: The hosted DID slot whose hosting state is being set.

state.description: Desired hosting state. `active`: the DID resolves normally. `suspended`: resolution returns a deactivation marker while the log and witness content are retained for recovery. Declarative — requesting the state the slot is already in is an idempotent no-op.

domain.description: Optional explicit hosting domain. When omitted, resolves via caller ACL default → system default. See category CONVENTIONS §1.
